SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Good morning. This is the study team calling ahead of your Cycle 5 visit. I have a few minutes of questions about your medications. Is now still a good time?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: Yes, that's fine.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Thank you. I have four medications on file. I will read them out, and you tell me if anything has changed. First, the cholesterol tablet, atorvastatin, twenty milligrams at night.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: The cholesterol tablet, yes, same as before, one at night.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Good. Next, allopurinol, three hundred milligrams once a day.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: They cut the allopurinol down to one small tablet in June.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Understood, so the hundred milligram tablet since June. And the omeprazole, twenty milligrams once a day for reflux?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: I came off the reflux one back in July. It was not doing much.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Noted, stopped in July. Do you remember roughly which part of July?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: No, I could not say. Sometime in the month.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: That is fine, I will record it as July. Now, has anything new been started since we last spoke? Anything at all, including things another doctor prescribed.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: My other doctor put me on prednisone for the joint pain. Twenty milligrams.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Thank you for telling me. I am flagging that for your coordinator to discuss at the visit. Have you had any vaccinations recently?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: I had the shingles jab at the pharmacy in August. Just the one shot.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Do you happen to remember the brand name on that one?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: No, sorry. They just called it the shingles one.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Not a problem, your coordinator will check it with the pharmacy. Anything else, even occasionally?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: Melatonin, the gummies, on and off for sleep. Years now.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: And do you know the strength on the melatonin?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: No idea, sorry.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: Not a problem. Anything else at all?

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: And there is a little blue pill I take for my stomach. I could not tell you the name.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0431.text: That is alright. Your coordinator will ask you to bring the bottle to the visit so we can record it properly. That is everything I needed. Thank you for your time.

SES-2026-0431.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0431.text: Thank you, goodbye.

SES-2026-0432.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0432.text: Good morning. This is the study team calling ahead of your Cycle 3 visit. Do you have a few minutes to go through your medications?

SES-2026-0432.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0432.text: Thank you. I have levothyroxine on file, seventy-five micrograms once daily. Is that still right?

SES-2026-0432.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0432.text: The thyroid one, every morning, no change.

SES-2026-0432.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0432.text: Good. Has anything new started since we last spoke, including any vaccinations?

SES-2026-0432.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0432.text: I got the flu vaccine last week. The nasal spray one, not the needle.

SES-2026-0432.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0432.text: Thank you for telling me, that detail matters. I am flagging it for your coordinator. Which pharmacy was that at?

SES-2026-0433.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0433.text: Good afternoon. This is the study team calling ahead of your Cycle 9 visit. I have a short set of questions about your medications. Is now a good time?

SES-2026-0433.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0433.text: Yes, go ahead. It will be quick though, I do not take anything.

SES-2026-0433.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0433.text: That is good to know. I have no concomitant medications on file for you, so I am checking whether anything has started since your last visit. Anything prescribed by another doctor?

SES-2026-0433.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0433.text: Anything you buy without a prescription — painkillers, antacids, anything for sleep?

SES-2026-0433.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0433.text: No. I have never been one for tablets.

SES-2026-0433.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0433.text: And vitamins, supplements or herbal products? People often do not think of those as medication.

SES-2026-0433.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0433.text: Any vaccinations in the last few months?

SES-2026-0433.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0433.text: No, not since the study started.

SES-2026-0433.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0433.text: Then there is nothing to change and your log is already accurate. Thank you for your time, and we will see you at the visit.

SES-2026-0429.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0429.text: Good morning. This is the study team calling ahead of your Cycle 7 visit. Do you have a few minutes to go through your medications?

SES-2026-0429.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0429.text: Thank you. I have one medication on file, acyclovir, four hundred milligrams twice a day. Is that still right?

SES-2026-0429.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0429.text: They put the acyclovir up to three a day.

SES-2026-0429.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0429.text: Understood, so four hundred milligrams three times daily. Do you remember roughly when that changed?

SES-2026-0429.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0429.text: A few weeks back, when the rash was starting.

SES-2026-0429.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0429.text: Thank you. Your coordinator will confirm the date against the prescription. Has anything else started or stopped?

SES-2026-0429.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0429.text: No, that is the only one.

SES-2026-0429.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0429.text: That is everything I needed. Thank you for your time.

SES-2026-0512.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0512.text: Good morning. This is the study team calling ahead of your Week 12 visit. I have a few questions about your medications. Is now still a good time?

SES-2026-0512.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0512.text: Thank you. I have two on file. First, amlodipine, five milligrams once a day for blood pressure.

SES-2026-0512.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0512.text: Blood pressure one, no change, same as always.

SES-2026-0512.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0512.text: Good. And levothyroxine, fifty micrograms once a day.

SES-2026-0512.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0512.text: The thyroid tablet went up after my last blood test. I take the 75 now.

SES-2026-0512.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0512.text: Noted, seventy-five micrograms. I will flag the timing for your coordinator to check. Has anything new started since we last spoke?

SES-2026-0512.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0512.text: My rheumatologist started me on methotrexate. One dose a week, on Sundays.

SES-2026-0512.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0512.text: Thank you for telling me. I am flagging that one for your coordinator to discuss at the visit. Do you know the strength?

SES-2026-0512.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0512.text: Fifteen milligrams, I think. It is on the box.

SES-2026-0512.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0512.text: That is helpful. Anything else at all, including anything over the counter?

SES-2026-0512.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0512.text: Thank you for your time. Your coordinator will go through the methotrexate with you at the visit.

SES-2026-0498.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0498.text: Good afternoon. This is the study team calling ahead of your Cycle 6 visit. Can I go through your medications with you?

SES-2026-0498.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0498.text: Thank you. I have ondansetron on file, eight milligrams twice a day as needed for nausea.

SES-2026-0498.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0498.text: I stopped the nausea tablets. I have not needed them since the end of July.

SES-2026-0498.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0498.text: Noted, stopped at the end of July. Was that a particular day you remember?

SES-2026-0498.speaker: participant
SES-2026-0498.text: The last one was the thirty-first, I remember because it was the end of the month.

SES-2026-0498.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0498.text: Thank you, that is precise enough to record. Has anything new started?

SES-2026-0498.speaker: agent
SES-2026-0498.text: That is everything I needed. Thank you for your time.
